name: Sakuma Kyouichi
source:
Zodiac: Capricorn

The perfect butler, having trained in the UK.

He is absolutely obedient to any instruction given by his master. However he can be too serious for his own good, his lack of humor doesn't help him either.

He is in charge of the butlers and thoroughly knows the mansion and other butlers well.
